ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:6 ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels; the visible fluke surface is dominated by low-intensity (dark) values with concentrated high-intensity (white) areas at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white blobs are localized at the extreme left and right distal tips. A narrow band of high-intensity pixels follows the leading edge of the left lobe. The central area and most of the interior surface consist of a continuous low-intensity dark field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex; estimated internal angle of approximately 30-35 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; frequency is high with peak-to-valley pixel amplitudes varying between 5 and 15 pixels. The left lobe exhibits more jagged, saw-toothed peaks compared to the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Curve fitted to the trailing edge indicates a moderate concavity from the median notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning to a sharp upward sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially dense clusters of circular high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacle colonization) are present at the tips of both lobes and along the outermost leading edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: At least four distinct vertical, low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the upper medial portion of the left lobe, cutting through the general pigment pattern.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical protrusions at the distal tips caused by barnacle encrustation; irregular indentation on the right lobe trailing edge that deviates from the standard serration frequency.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct asymmetry in the serration depth and frequency between the left and right lobes.
